query: SELECT world.id, world.name, world_owner.user_id AS owner_id, world.developer_mode AS "developer_mode: bool", world.initial_prompt AS seed, world.generation_stage = 'complete' AS "ready!: bool", (SELECT sequence.error FROM sequence WHERE sequence.world_id = world.id AND sequence.trigger = 'world generation' AND sequence.error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sequence.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS failure FROM world JOIN world_owner ON world_owner.world_id = world.id WHERE world.id = ?
